title: Silas and the Hollow
author: K. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
